case_name: SRL-2018 Workstation 04 — Memory Forensics (Only Compromised Endpoint)
description: Volatility3 memory analysis. 2 LOTL + code injection in 24 processes. The only compromised workstation in the SRL-2018 corpus out of 6 analyzed. Memory acquired 2018-09-06 — one day before final corpus snapshot. Late-stage endpoint compromise, possibly the attack's final objective.
devil_advocate: Workstations legitimately run security software that performs code injection (EDR agents). 24 injected processes could include legitimate security product hooks.

artifacts.content: vol3 windows.pslist LOLBAS: 2 living-off-the-land processes. cmd.exe or powershell.exe variants present. Memory acquisition 2018-09-06 — one day before final corpus snapshot.
forensic_anomalies: 2 LOTL on workstation with 24 injected processes: attacker operating quietly — data collection or credential harvesting mode, not active lateral movement
Acquisition date 2018-09-06 (one day before final snapshot) suggests this was a late-stage compromise — attacker reached endpoint objective after months of server operations
LOTL on workstation vs servers: workstation LOTL is more targeted — server LOTL is infrastructure, workstation LOTL indicates specific user data or credential objective

artifacts.content: vol3 windows.malfind: code injection in 24 processes (PIDs: 0f, 02, 0c, 68, c5 and 19 others). Highest injection count among all workstations (5/6 workstations clean). Windows 10 Enterprise, 2018-09-06.
forensic_anomalies: 24 injected processes on a workstation far exceeds any legitimate security software footprint — most EDR agents inject into 2-5 processes
Only 1 of 6 analyzed workstations compromised — targeted compromise, not broad endpoint spray. Attacker had specific knowledge of this workstation's value
Injection count (24) is disproportionate to LOTL count (2) — attacker deployed full payload with broad persistence but operated quietly (2 active LOTL only)

artifacts.content: WKSTN04 as final attack objective: lateral movement from RD-04 (primary C2 pivot) to WKSTN04 via RDP using legitimate domain credentials. Workstation connectivity to corporate data (file shares, email, internal applications) makes it the highest-value endpoint target for data exfiltration or credential collection.
forensic_anomalies: Workstation targeted after months of server-side operations (July-September 2018): suggests attacker was building toward endpoint access as a final objective, not opportunistic
RDP lateral movement from RD-04 to WKSTN04 using rsydow-a or cbarton-a credentials (both found on RD-02) — domain admin credentials used for final pivot to user endpoint
24 injections + quiet LOTL: attacker in data collection mode on workstation — exfiltration or credential harvesting occurring silently while maintaining low network noise
artifacts.source_tool: Corpus cross-analysis — RD-02 PowerShell transcripts + vol3 multi-host comparison

peirce_chain.firstness: Workstation in compromised enterprise — user data and credentials present
peirce_chain.secondness: 24 code injections + 2 LOTL confirmed — deliberate targeted compromise, not propagation artifact
peirce_chain.thirdness: Only 1/6 workstations compromised on the final day of the attack indicates WKSTN04 was a specific final objective. High injection count with minimal LOTL suggests silent data collection mode. Attacker completed server-side operations then targeted this specific endpoint.

_consolidation: VIGÍA-REAL. vol3 WKSTN04-001. Bundle: results/srl2018/WKSTN04-001_bundle.json. ONLY COMPROMISED WORKSTATION — final attack objective candidate.
